description: Compose assets into a scene and return a URL the user can OPEN and orbit. Use it instead of handing over a block of three.js the user cannot run. Every low poly model is free, so the scene it shows is one the user can build with no account. If a row is ever marked paid, the result says so and where to get it; pass that on.

ids.description: asset ids, in any order; up to 24

name: preview_scene
